## Итоговое исследовательское решение

**ACCEPT_RESEARCH_ONLY** — ограниченный статус работы, не разрешение внедрения. Procedural memory earned from resettable exercises and frozen before inference is a testable learning design.

Ограничения: Self-defined exercise success judged by LLM, not external oracle; the 3-success acceptance rule and API cost assume particular caching.

## Эксперименты

- daedalus-frozen-bank-20261126-lab: SYNTHETIC / OBSERVED. Twenty authored holdouts scored 10 without a bank, 15 with three-success selection, and 20 with reviewed preconditions. The upstream loader refused missing and empty banks. Authored rules and scripted environment. No automatic heuristic generation or agent quality estimate.
